about.title: Quality work at a reasonable rate
paragraphs: One Stop Construction & Handyman Services was founded in 1997 with one fundamental goal: do quality work at a reasonable rate. The rest is history!
Now in business for 20+ years and counting, we have built our business on repeat customers and positive word of mouth.
We are locally owned and operated and complete most projects using our own crews, so quality control is held to the highest standard. We pride ourselves on the work we complete.

services.name: Decks, Fences & Gates
services.blurb: New or repaired, from privacy fences to picket fences.
services.intro: Wanting to repair or replace an existing fence or deck? Maybe you want to install a new fence or deck. From privacy to picket fence, our crew is at your service.
photos: New cedar-toned deck with patio furniture
Arched cedar gate with an arbor
Cedar pergola over a flagstone circle

services.name: Painting & Wood Finishes
services.blurb: Interior and exterior painting, stain and varnish.
services.intro: A fresh coat of paint can help spruce up a place. Our crew can paint exteriors and interiors. We also provide stain and varnish services.
photos: Entry with new crown molding, columns and paint

services.name: Drywall & Texturing
services.blurb: New drywall, repairs and texture that matches.
services.intro: We install new drywall and repair or replace existing drywall. Our texturing service is a good way to make drywall more appealing and can also hide imperfections. Our crew has the special tools needed to get great results.
photos: Finished hallway with new floor and paint
Entry with new crown molding, columns and paint

services.name: Siding, Windows & Carpentry
services.blurb: New siding, repairs and finish carpentry.
services.intro: New siding is an excellent way to give a house a dramatic makeover with a material that is nearly maintenance free. We install new siding or repair and replace damaged siding. Our finish carpenters hang doors, install moldings and stair rails, and match existing trim.
photos: New siding on a house wall
Arched window set in new siding

services.name: Remodels, Tile & Flooring
services.blurb: Kitchens, baths and floors, start to finish.
services.intro: Considering some remodeling or finishing a space? Tile can dramatically change the look of a bathroom, kitchen or fireplace. We handle all the prep work, including removing old tile or flooring, and install everything from simple to elaborate designs. We also repair and install a variety of floor coverings.
photos: Kitchen with a new tile backsplash
Bathroom with a new tile tub surround
New plank flooring in a laundry room

services.name: Rental Turnovers & Property Maintenance
services.blurb: For homeowners, realtors and property managers.
services.intro: One Stop is a full service general contractor specializing in maintenance and repair projects for homeowners, realtors, development companies, and apartment and property managers. We complete most projects with our own crews, so quality control stays in our hands.
